assets.gate_reason: S17: the Dreamscape plane's void (void.lua OUTERSPACE, the Forest generator's wall) needs a dream-themed board void beside the new cloud floor. One opaque void master; exporter crops 2 windows x 2 parities, unmasked (the cloud side carries the rim). Rules unchanged (blocks movement, not sight, no damage). No waiver.
assets.scope: void.lua OUTERSPACE as placed in the Dreamscape talent plane only (its Forest generator wall); Point Zero, Abashed Expanse and Temporal Reprieve keep the existing board space.

references.note: The accepted dream cloud floor that borders this void. Match its soft painted cloud handling and cool lavender hue family; the void must be far darker and emptier so the cloud floor reads as the only walkable ground.
Accepted board impassable-void master: flat overhead matte finish, deep indigo value range and texture scale. Not its fractured crystal shards or cyan cracks; the dream void is smooth, soft haze.

grid_contract.movement: Blocks movement (impassable void); only void-passing creatures could cross.
grid_contract.sight: Does not block sight or projectiles; it is open empty space.
grid_contract.danger: None: no callback, no damage. It is empty sky, not lava, poison, a portal or a trap.
grid_contract.export: Opaque full-bleed material; the exporter crops 2 windows and 2 checker parities with no mask; the cloud tiles next to it carry the rim.

prompt_fields.subject: The empty abyss of a dream seen from straight above, far below a floating cloud floor: deep, soft indigo-violet haze with a few very faint, blurred, distant cloud wisps drifting far down in the depth; calm, quiet, empty space with nothing to stand on.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep indigo, dark violet and blue-black, with the faint distant wisps only slightly lighter dusky lavender; overall very dark (roughly a fifth of the brightness of the pale cloud floor), low saturation, no bright spots.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as empty, impassable depth: a dark, quiet, almost uniform field that the pale cloud floor clearly stands out against, so it does NOT read as floor, water, lava, poison, a starfield, a portal, a vortex or a wall.
prompt_fields.composition: Edge-to-edge overhead material filling the whole square; soft, non-directional haze with the faint wisps spread evenly, reaching all four edges; no border, rim, cloud edge, platform, object, star, planet, swirl, rune, symbol or glow.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Impassable empty void, harmless. Paint no floor, bridge, stairs, portal, character, warning sign, symbol or text.
